contradictions.explanation: With only three shifts, having Ben, Rosa, and Quinn all pairwise different requires exactly three distinct shifts, which is possible, but combined with other statements about their arrival order and activities implying overlapping presence, this is not actually a strict contradiction—however, if only three shifts exist and all three pairs differ, each must occupy a separate shift, which is consistent, so no contradiction arises here after all.
